dataset: Survey of India Administrative Boundary Database (ABDB), State/District/Sub-District PAN INDIA
authority: Survey of India, Department of Science & Technology, Government of India
scope: Administrative/geospatial boundaries only; not individual parcel ownership, title, mutation, encumbrance or legal-rights data.
coordinateReferenceSystem: LCC_WGS84 (Lambert Conformal Conic; source PRJ files included in archive)

normalization.masterStateUt: DoLR 36-State/UT register and current LGD codes
normalization.sourceIds: ABDB source LGD codes retained separately; they are not silently rewritten to current LGD identifiers.

note: ABDB is a geographic administrative reference, not a land-title register. Its 780 named/assigned district features and 6,578 complete sub-district rows do not exactly equal the DILRMP totals. Four disputed state-level shapes and 28 disputed/unassigned district features are excluded from the normal hierarchy; 89 sub-district features lack required attributes. Arunachal Pradesh and Meghalaya have no indexed sub-district rows in this supplied archive.
